actor: candidate (admitted isolated execution capability: python_execute, stdlib-only, fresh empty filesystem, no network, cgroup limits per receipt)
scope_statement: All witnesses are isolated component checks of candidate-authored logic on tiny synthetic data. A passing result demonstrates the candidate-authored mechanism only; it does not establish DuckDB, ipykernel, or any full-application behavior, nor properties of large real datasets.

witnesses.title: Data-contract import: strict types, quarantine not deletion, stable row identity, source not mutated

final_receipt.stdout_summary: manifest: rows_parsed=4, rows_quarantined=2 with line+reason (line 4 "val='notanumber': invalid literal for int()", line 6 "column count 1 != 3"); source_sha256 constant before/after; row identity = original line number + content hash; contract distinguishes required id/ts (empty -> error) from nullable val (empty -> null)

witnesses.expected_behavior_justification: A contract-driven parser must (a) reject typed values failing conversion with a retained raw line and reason, (b) keep ordinal line identity so downstream joins/diffs are stable, (c) never write to the source, (d) honor declared nullability instead of guessing. Each is asserted.

prior_failed_attempts.failure: AssertionError: rows_parsed==3 vs expected 4 — candidate test-data bug: row 2 had empty 'ts' while the contract declared ts required; witness data contradicted its own contract.
prior_failed_attempts.disposition: test data fixed (empty moved to nullable column val); code logic unchanged

prior_failed_attempts.failure: AssertionError on expected line numbers [2,3,5,8] vs actual [2,3,5,7] — candidate arithmetic error counting fixture lines.

witnesses.title: Provenance/status engine: code+dep+data+env hashes -> current/stale; transitive staleness; restart -> unverified; execution order distinct from display order

final_receipt.stdout_summary: baseline [current,current]; edit upstream cell -> [stale,stale]; restore -> [current,current]; source dataset change -> [stale,stale] (transitive through A); env change -> [stale,stale]; kernel restart -> [unverified,unverified]; exec_seq (A,B) = (1,2) in clean run vs (2,1) in messy run under identical display order

witnesses.expected_behavior_justification: Status must be a pure function of recorded hashes vs current hashes; staleness must propagate along dependency edges (a downstream cell can look hash-identical yet depend on stale upstream); kernel restart must downgrade to unverified rather than silently labeling old outputs current; execution order must be recorded independently of the cells array order.

prior_failed_attempts.failure: AssertionError: r4 == ['stale','current'] — source-dataset change marked only the reading cell stale; downstream cell stayed 'current' because only its own hashes were checked.
prior_failed_attempts.disposition: revealed a real modeling gap: rule corrected to transitive propagation via dependency edges (status(dep) must be current). This failed receipt is retained as evidence the rule was derived, not assumed.

witnesses.title: Bounded preview cannot prove a full-dataset property; deterministic recomputation is byte-identical

final_receipt.stdout_summary: preview (first 500 of 10,000 deterministic rows): {min:0, has_negative:false}; full scan: {min:-1, has_negative:true}; preview_supports_full_claim=false; deterministic replay identical=true
final_receipt.limits: same sandbox profile; tiny synthetic data (LCG-seeded), mirrors at miniature scale the DuckDB sample_size asymmetry documented in S4/S5

witnesses.expected_behavior_justification: Any product surface that shows a sampled preview must not present it as evidence about unsampled rows; the check demonstrates a concrete property (presence of negative values) that the sample gets wrong. Determinism assertion validates the stable-recomputation premise used by output comparison.

not_executed: No DuckDB, ipykernel, nbclient, DVC, or any packaged runtime was executed; no large dataset was processed; no sandbox-escape tests were run. All such validation is PROPOSED/UNEXECUTED (proposal.md §14).
